name: Sentinel Onaeya
summary: At Maestra's Post, Sentinel Onaeya, a night elf guardian, rallies aid for Ashenvale's northern edge. She guards the forest and calls travelers to defend the outpost and help fellow sentinels.

sections.title: A Guard on the Frontier
sections.body: Maestra's Post guards the road from Darkshore into Ashenvale. Sentinel Onaeya watches the lodge outside the settlement and directs its defense. Hostile wildlife and corrupting forces threaten night elf settlements nearby. Tensions along the border add to the danger.

sections.title: Holding the Post
sections.body: Sentinel Onaeya learns that furbolgs attacked Sentinel Aynasha in Darkshore while she carried an important message. Aynasha is poisoned, so Onaeya asks travelers to protect her until the antidote takes effect. She rewards those who keep her safe.

faq.answer: Sentinel Onaeya is a night elf guardian at Maestra's Post in northwestern Ashenvale. She directs travelers to help defend the outpost.
Sentinel Onaeya stands outside the main building at Maestra's Post, along the northern road in Ashenvale just below the border with Darkshore.

faq.q: What faction does Sentinel Onaeya belong to?
faq.answer: Sentinel Onaeya belongs to the Night Elf Sentinels and is loyal to the Alliance. Horde travelers find her hostile on sight.

faq.q: How is Onaeya connected to Sentinel Aynasha?
faq.answer: After adventurers protect Sentinel Aynasha from attacking furbolgs, Aynasha sends them to report to Onaeya at Maestra's Post. Onaeya rewards them and is glad Aynasha survived.

faq.q: What kind of tasks does Sentinel Onaeya give?
faq.answer: Onaeya rewards adventurers who protect Sentinel Aynasha from furbolgs in Darkshore and bring word of her safety to Maestra's Post.

faq.q: Why is Maestra's Post important to the Sentinels?
faq.answer: Maestra's Post is a checkpoint linking Darkshore's supply routes to Ashenvale's heart. Holding it keeps hostile forces from cutting off night elf travelers moving south.

angles.text: As a night elf traveling south from Darkshore, you find Onaeya on the front line defending Ashenvale woodland from outside threats.
As an Alliance traveler, you can help Onaeya defend the outpost as you leave the coastal wilds for Ashenvale's contested forests.
As a Horde traveler, you face Onaeya, a sentinel guarding Maestra's Post and Ashenvale's northern approaches.
